import sys
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Add the report generator to path
sys.path.append('/root/.gemini/skills/report-generator')
from scripts.report_gen import ReportGenerator

def main():
    # 1. Load Data
    df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')
    
    # Preprocessing
    df['is_decisive'] = df['winner'].isin(['white', 'black'])
    df['white_win'] = df['winner'] == 'white'
    df['black_win'] = df['winner'] == 'black'
    df['draw'] = df['winner'] == 'draw'
    
    df['avg_rating'] = (df['white_rating'] + df['black_rating']) / 2
    rating_bins = [0, 1200, 1500, 1800, 2100, 3000]
    rating_labels = ['<1200', '1200-1499', '1500-1799', '1800-2099', '2100+']
    df['rating_bracket'] = pd.cut(df['avg_rating'], bins=rating_bins, labels=rating_labels)
    
    df['rating_diff'] = df['white_rating'] - df['black_rating']
    df['abs_rating_diff'] = df['rating_diff'].abs()
    
    # Calculate higher rated win
    df['higher_rated_won'] = np.where(
        df['winner'] == 'draw', False,
        np.where(
            (df['rating_diff'] > 0) & (df['winner'] == 'white'), True,
            np.where((df['rating_diff'] < 0) & (df['winner'] == 'black'), True, False)
        )
    )
    
    # Filter decisive games to check probability higher rated wins
    decisive_df = df[df['is_decisive']].copy()
    
    # Time Control categorization (top 5)
    top_time_controls = df['increment_code'].value_counts().head(5).index.tolist()
    df['time_control_group'] = df['increment_code'].apply(lambda x: x if x in top_time_controls else 'Other')
    decisive_df['time_control_group'] = decisive_df['increment_code'].apply(lambda x: x if x in top_time_controls else 'Other')
    
    # Create the report
    report = ReportGenerator("Lichess Chess Game Analytics", subtitle="Patterns of Victory, Openings, and Player Dynamics")
    report.set_author("Data Analytics Team")
    report.set_date_auto()
    
    report.add_text("This comprehensive analysis examines over 20,000 chess games played on Lichess.org. The objective is to identify patterns surrounding color advantage, rating dynamics, opening strategies, and time control impacts on game outcomes.")
    report.add_divider()
    
    # --- Section 1: Dataset Overview ---
    report.start_section("Dataset Overview & Game Distribution")
    total_games = len(df)
    rated_pct = (df['rated'].sum() / total_games) * 100
    
    overview_text = (f"The dataset contains {total_games:,} games, of which {rated_pct:.1f}% are rated. "
                     f"This analysis will focus on understanding the primary factors leading to victory.")
    report.add_text(overview_text)
    
    # Winner Dist
    winner_dist = df['winner'].value_counts().reset_index()
    winner_dist.columns = ['Winner', 'Count']
    winner_dist['Percentage'] = (winner_dist['Count'] / total_games * 100).round(1).astype(str) + '%'
    report.add_table(winner_dist, title="Overall Winner Distribution")
    
    # Victory Status
    victory_dist = df['victory_status'].value_counts().reset_index()
    victory_dist.columns = ['Status', 'Count']
    report.add_chart(victory_dist, "bar", x="Status", y="Count", title="Distribution of Victory Status")
    report.end_section()
    
    # --- Section 2: White vs Black ---
    report.start_section("White vs. Black: The First-Move Advantage")
    total_decisive = decisive_df.shape[0]
    white_wins = decisive_df['white_win'].sum()
    white_win_rate = white_wins / total_decisive
    report.add_text(f"Across all decisive games (excluding draws), White won {white_wins:,} games out of {total_decisive:,}, representing a win rate of {white_win_rate*100:.2f}%. This confirms the existence of a statistically meaningful first-move advantage.")
    
    # By Rating Bracket
    wb_rating = decisive_df.groupby('rating_bracket')['white_win'].mean().reset_index()
    wb_rating['White Win Rate (%)'] = (wb_rating['white_win'] * 100).round(2)
    wb_rating.rename(columns={'rating_bracket': 'Rating Bracket'}, inplace=True)
    report.add_chart(wb_rating, "bar", x="Rating Bracket", y="White Win Rate (%)", title="White Win Rate by Rating Bracket")
    report.add_table(wb_rating[['Rating Bracket', 'White Win Rate (%)']], title="Win Rates by Bracket")
    
    # By Time Control
    wb_tc = decisive_df[decisive_df['time_control_group'] != 'Other'].groupby('time_control_group')['white_win'].mean().reset_index()
    wb_tc['White Win Rate (%)'] = (wb_tc['white_win'] * 100).round(2)
    wb_tc.rename(columns={'time_control_group': 'Time Control'}, inplace=True)
    report.add_chart(wb_tc, "bar", x="Time Control", y="White Win Rate (%)", title="White Win Rate by Top Time Controls")
    report.end_section()
